intent.proves: Every unit group that a field uses has a base unit that is one of its own units.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global; at least one subject must be in scope

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(g.FieldValueConversionGroupSystemName AS nvarchar(100)) FROM EcomFieldValueConversionGroup g WHERE (g.FieldValueConversionGroupId IN (SELECT FieldValueConversionGroupId FROM EcomProductCategoryField) OR g.FieldValueConversionGroupId IN (SELECT ProductFieldValueConversionGroupId FROM EcomProductField)) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomFieldValueConversion c WHERE c.FieldValueConversionParentGroupId = g.FieldValueConversionGroupId AND c.FieldValueConversionId = g.FieldValueConversionGroupBaseUnitId))
bindings.subjectsQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomFieldValueConversionGroup g WHERE g.FieldValueConversionGroupId IN (SELECT FieldValueConversionGroupId FROM EcomProductCategoryField) OR g.FieldValueConversionGroupId IN (SELECT ProductFieldValueConversionGroupId FROM EcomProductField)
